option_relations.rationale: The option Amelanotic Malignant Melanoma matches the leaf label Amelanotic Malignant Melanoma of the Caruncle, indicating a direct equivalence in diagnosis.
Caruncular melanoma is a subtype of melanoma that can be amelanotic, relating to both B1.1 and B1.3, which describe specific types of melanomas.
Amelanotic Melanoma is a broader category that includes melanomas of the caruncle and conjunctiva, thus it is a supertype of the specific leaf labels.
Conjunctival melanoma (amelanotic variant) directly matches the leaf label, indicating equivalence.
